seoTitle: Veep Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Veep test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Selina, Amy, Dan, Gary, Jonah, Mike, Kent or Richard — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the politician, the fixer, or the one nobody likes? Answer 11 everyday questions about work, ambition and getting ahead, and find out which Veep character you are.

characters.name: Selina Meyer
characters.title: The Politician
characters.summary: Ambitious, image-obsessed and ruthless when it counts. You want the top job, and you'll do whatever it takes.
description: Like Selina, you're ambitious. She's a former Maryland senator who becomes vice president.
You fight your way to the top. Selina becomes president when the president resigns, and she keeps running even after she loses.
You care how things look. Selina is obsessed with her image, and her relationship with her family is strained.
characters.flaw: You'd blame anyone in the room before you'd blame yourself.
characters.signature: A perfect smile for the cameras and a furious rant the second they're off.
characters.clashReason: they'd throw you under the bus to save their own image

characters.name: Amy Brookheimer
characters.title: The Fixer
characters.summary: Driven, controlling and running on no sleep. You hold everything together, and you never let anyone forget it.
description: Like Amy, you hold everything together. She's Selina's chief of staff, and later her campaign manager.
You'll take the hit for the boss. Amy often sacrifices her own reputation to protect Selina.
You know your worth. At one point, Amy even manages a rival campaign against Selina.
characters.flaw: You work so hard that you forget to have a life.
characters.signature: Three phones, a to-do list on fire and zero hours of sleep.
characters.clashReason: they'd snap at you for doing it wrong, then redo it themselves

characters.name: Dan Egan
characters.title: The Climber
characters.summary: Charming, slick and always working the room. You know exactly who's useful, and you'll land on your feet.
description: Like Dan, you know how to network. He starts as deputy communications director in the vice president's office.
You always land on your feet. Dan is fired again and again, but he still finds work as a lobbyist and on TV.
You'll try anything once. In the end, Dan leaves politics for a career in real estate.
characters.flaw: You'd drop a friend the moment someone more useful walked in.
characters.signature: A great haircut, a full contacts list and a plan to get ahead.
characters.clashReason: they'd be your best friend until someone more useful showed up

characters.name: Gary Walsh
characters.title: The Devoted One
characters.summary: Loyal, attentive and completely devoted. You'd do anything for the people you care about, and you remember everything.
description: Like Gary, you're incredibly loyal. He's Selina's personal aide, and he's devoted to her.
Nothing keeps you from your people. When Selina becomes president, Gary struggles to stay close to her because he doesn't have security clearance.
You stick around. Gary stays on as Selina's aide even after she loses her reelection.
characters.flaw: You care so much about others that you forget about yourself.
characters.signature: A bag full of everything someone might need, and a very worried face.
characters.clashReason: they'd take your criticism of someone they love very, very personally

characters.name: Jonah Ryan
characters.title: The One Nobody Likes
characters.summary: Loud, confident and blissfully unaware. You think you're going places, and somehow you are.
description: Like Jonah, you're full of confidence. He starts as the White House liaison, and almost everyone he meets dislikes him.
You somehow keep rising. Jonah wins a seat in Congress with help from his uncle, and later runs for president.
You get closer to the top than anyone expected. Jonah becomes vice president, and then he's impeached.
characters.flaw: You talk about yourself so much that nobody else gets a word in.
characters.signature: A loud voice, a big opinion and no idea what the room thinks of you.
characters.clashReason: they'd brag at you for an hour without asking a single question

characters.name: Mike McLintock
characters.title: The One Just Getting By
characters.summary: Easygoing, unambitious and always looking for the easy way out. You're just trying to get through the day.
description: Like Mike, you're just trying to get through the day. He's the vice president's communications director, and later White House press secretary.
Family matters to you. Mike marries reporter Wendy Keegan, and they grow their family through adoption and surrogacy.
Things work out for you, somehow. Mike goes back to journalism with a podcast, and by 2045 he's a veteran news anchor.
characters.flaw: You'd rather dodge a problem than deal with it.
characters.signature: A vague answer, a long lunch and an early exit.
characters.clashReason: they'd disappear the minute things got difficult

characters.name: Kent Davison
characters.title: The Numbers Man
characters.summary: Cold, precise and ruled by data. You trust the numbers, and you don't do feelings.
description: Like Kent, you trust the data. He's a senior strategist to the president, and later chief strategist for Selina's campaign.
You keep your feelings out of it. Kent is cold, precise and obsessed with polling and statistics.
You know when to walk away. When Selina picks Jonah as her running mate, Kent leaves politics for good.
characters.flaw: You'd rather trust a spreadsheet than a person.
characters.signature: A spreadsheet, a flat voice and a poll for every occasion.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn your feelings into a percentage and tell you it's statistically insignificant

characters.name: Richard Splett
characters.title: The Underestimated One
characters.summary: Cheerful, kind and much smarter than people think. You're happy to be underestimated, and then you win.
description: Like Richard, you're cheerful and kind. He starts as a campaign aide, and people often make him the butt of the joke.
You're smarter than you look. Selina promotes Richard after finding out he has a doctorate in political science.
You end up on top. Richard goes on to be governor of Iowa, and in 2040 he's elected president.
characters.flaw: You're so nice that people walk all over you.
characters.signature: A big smile, a fun fact nobody asked for and a surprisingly impressive résumé.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay cheerful no matter how annoyed you were

questions.text: Your team's big project fails, and everyone knows about it. You...

options.text: Blame someone else before lunch
Take charge, and start barking out orders
Make sure your name is nowhere near it
Hide in the break room until it blows over

questions.text: Someone new moves in next door. You...

options.text: Wave, and hope they don't want to chat
Offer to help with anything they need
Tell them all about yourself, at length
Welcome them warmly, with a homemade gift

questions.text: Your boss asks for your honest opinion. You...

options.text: Tell them exactly what they want to hear
Give them the numbers. Feelings aren't data
Tell them bluntly, then fix the problem yourself
Say something vague and hope that's enough

questions.text: You've got a free weekend. You...

options.text: Try to relax, and check your email every ten minutes
Go to a party where you'll meet the right people
Sleep in, then take a very long lunch
Dive into a hobby nobody else understands

questions.text: Someone online is criticizing you. You...

options.text: Fire back right away with something you'll regret
Check whether it's moving the numbers
Demand that somebody, anybody, make it go away
Find out who's behind it, and quietly get even

questions.text: You're asked to give a speech you haven't prepared. You...

options.text: Wing it, and somehow make it all about you
Read whatever someone else wrote, with a perfect smile
Make it warm, sincere and a little bit strange
Recite the relevant statistics from memory

questions.text: A friend forgets your birthday. You...

options.text: Remember it for the rest of your life
Say it doesn't matter, then get upset about it later
Remind them, loudly, every day for a week
Let it go, as long as there's cake later

questions.text: You're planning a trip with friends. You...

options.text: Agree to go, without showing any emotion about it
Plan everything, then get furious when nobody sticks to it
Pack a few extras for everyone, just in case
Suggest your hometown. It's honestly underrated

questions.text: You overhear coworkers gossiping about your boss. You...

options.text: Join in, and remember everything for later
Add your own opinion, loudly, just as your boss walks in
Shut it down. Nobody has time for this
Pretend you didn't hear, and keep eating your sandwich

questions.text: You're the vice president, and nobody takes you seriously. You...

options.text: Plot your way to the top job, whatever it takes
Run for president anyway. People will love you eventually
Work out exactly which voters you need, to the decimal
Make friends with everyone, sincerely, and wait your turn

questions.text: Your boss's campaign is falling apart a week before election day. You...

options.text: Work 20-hour days to hold it all together
Quietly start talking to the other side about a job
Stay by your boss's side, no matter what
Give the press a quote you instantly regret
